home.bioParagraph1: Hello! I'm Fran, a recent Computer Engineering graduate from the University of León (ULE). Having finished my studies and defended my Final Degree Project last July, I am looking for my first full-time role as a Full-Stack software developer. My goal is to join a team where I can add value and continue growing professionally, whether that's creating custom software for clients or driving the development of an in-house product.
home.bioParagraph2: To get to know me better, I invite you to explore my portfolio. In the projects section and on my personal blog, where I document my progress, you can take a look at the personal developments I regularly work on. In them, I put into practice what I've learned and explore new tools to continue expanding my technical skills.
home.bioParagraph3: If my profile fits what you are looking for, I would love to chat. You can find my email, phone number, and LinkedIn profile in the Contact section.
home.experienceIntro: A brief overview of my professional background and key strengths:
home.experienceItem1: Developing responsive web applications using React and modern CSS.
home.experienceItem2: State management and consumption of RESTful APIs in production environments.
home.experienceItem3: Optimizing user interfaces to improve accessibility and overall performance.
